marc:datafield.marc:subfield: In this charming, critically acclaimed tale of rumors and reputation, Olive an average high school student, sees her below-the-radar existence turn around overnight once she dicides to use the school's grapevine to advance her social standing. Now her classmate are turning against her and the school board is becoming concerned, including her favorite teacher and the distracted guidance counselor. Eith the support of her hilariously idiosyncratic parents and a little help from a long-time crush to take on her notorious new identity and crush the rumor mill once and for all
